home.heroTitle: Rehabilitate effectively with {accent} recovery plans and clinical tracking.
home.heroSubtitle: Jolna is a digital physiotherapy platform designed for a Cambodian clinic. We empower physiotherapists to assign custom protocols and track recovery indices while providing patients with daily guided routines.
home.feature1Desc: Create client profiles, register patients, and assign them directly to designated clinic physiotherapists.
home.feature2Desc: Patients review daily prescribed exercise schedules, watch clinic video tutorials, and report daily completion.
home.feature3Desc: Physiotherapists monitor daily pain progress, logs, and calendar schedules to track patient compliance.
